name: Web Studio Šime – Sidrena cijena HR for WooCommerce
author: Web Studio Šime

sections.description:
Web Studio Šime – Sidrena cijena HR for WooCommerce is a free WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for technical management of anchor/reference prices and machine-readable public price lists.

WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc. This plugin is an independent extension and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic.

The plugin stores the anchor price separately from the current WooCommerce price. A normal product price change does not automatically overwrite the stored anchor price. Products, services, and WooCommerce variations are supported.

Main features:

  • anchor/reference price and reference date per item and variation
  • separate handling of products and services
  • optional anchor-price display in product archives and single-product pages
  • optional display in cart and checkout
  • tracking of the lowest applied price during the previous 30 days before a special sale
  • separate public CSV/XML price lists for products and services
  • a public human-readable digital price-list page
  • archived price-list states with duplicate-state protection
  • automatic and manual snapshot creation
  • paginated REST/JSON output
  • safe CSV import/export for historical and reference-price data with preview before applying changes
  • two original XLSX working templates for products and services
  • bulk administration tools for larger catalogs
  • an onboarding wizard for business information and price-list settings
  • technical checks for missing data
  • WP-CLI snapshot command and read-only benchmark
  • HPOS compatibility declaration
  • Croatian and English administration interface using native WordPress gettext (explicit plugin setting; real bundled Croatian translation)
  • WordPress Dashboard status widget

The public product price list uses 11 columns, while the public service price list uses 5 columns. Service entries do not inherit product-only data such as SKU, brand, barcode, or unit of measure.

Important: this plugin is a technical tool. It is not legal advice, a legal opinion, or a guarantee of regulatory compliance. The site owner is responsible for the accuracy of historical prices and for determining which legal requirements apply to the business.

The interface language is selected in plugin Settings independently of the WordPress site/user locale. English is the canonical gettext source; WordPress.org/translate.wordpress.org Croatian packs are supported, with a bundled Croatian fallback. The public digital catalogue and stored statutory price labels remain Croatian. See docs/LOCALIZATION.md.

Legal References

  • Croatian Consumer Protection Act amendments NN 59/2026: https://narodne-novine.nn.hr/clanci/sluzbeni/2026_06_59_728.html

The automatic reference concerns the standard preceding-30-day rule and uninterrupted reductions. Missing pre-installation history is not invented. Special legal regimes, including perishable goods, require the merchant to verify applicability and the correct reference; the plugin does not infer these from Woo product types. The anchor/reference date is a separate concept from the 30-day sale reference. Media-X Lowest Price 2.1.5 co-installation is not supported because its price HTML may replace the anchor output or duplicate the 30-day reference.

  • Croatian Official Gazette NN 101/2026 — decision concerning additional price display: https://narodne-novine.nn.hr/clanci/sluzbeni/2026_09_101_1212.html
  • Croatian Official Gazette NN 101/2026 — decision concerning publication of product and service price lists: https://narodne-novine.nn.hr/clanci/sluzbeni/2026_09_101_1213.html

Support

Open WooCommerce > Sidrena cijena HR > Help / Instructions inside WordPress administration. Technical support information is also available from the author website listed in the plugin header.
sections.installation:
1. Back up the WordPress site and database.
  2. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  3. Install and activate Web Studio Šime – Sidrena cijena HR for WooCommerce.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Sidrena cijena HR > Initial setup.
  5. Complete the wizard and enter the business and sales/service location information.
  6. Verify the actual historical/reference prices. The plugin does not invent historical values automatically.
  7. Open the technical check and review any items that require attention.
  8. Generate a test snapshot and manually verify the public CSV/XML files.
sections.faq:
How does automatic publishing run?

Scheduled events are not proof of execution. Version 1.0.3 records actual automatic attempts, completion, results and safe error codes. The primary morning run is 06:30 with verification at 07:00, 07:30 and 07:50 in the WordPress time zone. Unchanged verified states do not regenerate files. Failures receive up to six recovery attempts per catalog mutation/day; morning checks continue on later days.

For deadline-sensitive use, configure a server runner every minute to execute wp-cron.php or wp cron event run --due-now. PHP/WordPress must actually run. Visitor-driven WP-Cron cannot guarantee timing without visits. DISABLE_WP_CRON alone does not prove whether an external runner works. Late or failed execution is not success, and this tool does not guarantee legal compliance.

Archive validation uses PHP XMLReader. Archive publication uses local same-filesystem directory rename; unavailable filesystem/database access fails safely and keeps the previous archive. Main downloads use live endpoints, while historical archive URLs remain unchanged. The legacy snapshot_time setting is retained for compatibility; the morning schedule uses the four fixed slots above.

Does the plugin automatically change the anchor price when I change a WooCommerce price?

No. The anchor price is stored as a separate historical/reference value. A normal change of the current WooCommerce price does not overwrite it.

Will the plugin invent a historical price if one is missing?

No. Bulk filling from the current regular price is an administrator-triggered action and should be used only when the current regular price is known to match the relevant historical value.

Are variable products supported?

Yes. Each WooCommerce variation can have its own current, anchor, and reference-price data. The frontend output updates after the customer selects a variation.

Can products and services be separated?

Yes. The plugin maintains and publishes separate product and service price lists. Product-only fields are not required for service entries.

What does the snapshot archive do?

It stores previous public price-list states in CSV/XML format. When the exported data has not changed, an identical duplicate snapshot is skipped.

Does the plugin send data to third parties?

No. The free plugin contains no telemetry or tracking and does not send catalog data to external services. CSV/XML/REST price-list routes are intentionally public while the plugin and WooCommerce are active. The setting for the human-readable digital price list controls the HTML page only; disabling that page does not disable the CSV/XML/REST routes. Review the export scope and included catalog data before activating the plugin.

What happens when the plugin is deactivated or deleted?

Deactivation does not remove stored anchor-price data or the snapshot archive. The plugin intentionally does not automatically erase those records during uninstall, reducing the risk of accidental loss of historical data.

What are the included XLSX files for?

They are original Web Studio Šime working templates for product and service price lists. They are included as data files because administrators can download them directly from the Import / Export tab and use them to prepare price-list data.

Is there a paid upgrade?

Yes. A separate PRO add-on is distributed outside WordPress.org. The free version is fully functional on its own and does not expire or become locked after a trial period. PRO adds advanced administration tools but is not required for the free features to work.

Does the plugin guarantee legal compliance?

No. The plugin provides technical tools for recording and publishing data. The site owner must verify the legal applicability of the rules and the accuracy of the stored values.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Include the price effective at the start of the preceding 30-day window, including unchanged prices recorded earlier.
  • Do not publish an unverified numeric reference when automatic history is incomplete; preserve manually verified references.
  • Match the 30-day reference to WooCommerce storefront tax display without changing stored prices or public feeds.
  • Display the 30-day reference independently of the anchor price, including variations and subscription price output.
  • Revalidate older automatic references and preserve history, archives, scheduling and public CSV/XML schemas.

1.0.4

  • Bounded current CSV/XML preparation, cache invalidation and recovery for small catalogues.
  • Preserve atomic archive/index commits and truthful execution markers.
  • Coordinate public reads and morning publication with PRO background work.
  • Tested locally with 30, 500 and 1,000 items including services and variations; no artificial product-count limit.
  • Preserve existing prices, reference dates, settings and archive data.

1.0.3

  • Added a separate Live automated retrieval card with existing CSV, XML, JSON API and manifest URLs, and clearly labelled historical archives.
  • Improved daily pre-08:00 publishing reliability with morning reconciliation at 06:30, 07:00, 07:30 and 07:50 (WordPress time zone).
  • Added bounded retry/recovery and execution status tracking for automatic snapshots.
  • Added validated atomic archive-pair publication and verified archive-index commits.
  • Corrected main current CSV/XML downloads and immediate scheduling for morning changes.
  • Improved recurring/subscription price display compatibility.

1.0.2

  • WordPress.org review fix: XML feed generation no longer accepts generic URIs or uses direct PHP file access for XML output. XML is generated in memory and local cache/snapshot files are written through the WordPress Filesystem API.

1.0.1

  • Hardened public output against unpublished and password-protected products.
  • Safer default public scope excludes catalog-hidden products.
  • Added short-lived caching for public REST/CSV/XML output with immediate invalidation after catalog/settings changes.
  • Cached product/service counts and reduced repeated catalog scans on anonymous requests.
  • Shortcode no longer renders data for unpublished or password-protected products.

1.0.0

  • First stable release.
  • Separate public CSV/XML price lists for products and services, plus a human-readable public price list and archive.
  • Anchor/reference prices for simple and variable WooCommerce items.
  • Automatic and manual snapshots with identical-state duplicate protection.
  • Safe CSV import/export and original XLSX templates for products and services.
  • Technical checks, bulk actions, WP-CLI support, and HPOS compatibility.
  • Croatian/English administration interface and WordPress Dashboard widget.
  • Final regression testing completed on the 1.0 release line before publication.

Detailed development history is available in CHANGELOG.md.
